name: daemonwatch
description: Schedule Witching Hour on-call drills for a team, run them in the shared sandbox, and review every player's scored postmortem.
author: matt869

crons.name: weekday-drills
crons.message: Run today's Daemonwatch drills. Use the haunting-playbook skill: list today's drills with list_drills (today's date in UTC), rehearse each drill's haunting in the sandbox (apply, check its signals, then always revert), and post a summary: which drills are due today and for whom, whether each haunting rehearsed cleanly, and results recorded so far with drill_results. Never leave a haunting applied.

setup.onInstall: cd ui && if [ ! -f dist/index.mjs ]; then npm install --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build:crew; fi
setup.onUpdate: cd ui && if [ ! -f dist/index.mjs ]; then npm install --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build:crew; fi

gameServerUrl.description: The Witching Hour game server. Must be on this machine (it binds 127.0.0.1). The backend reads it from DAEMONWATCH_GAME_SERVER_URL.
